metrics: alpha mean and median per state
disturbed-to-y00 alpha mean ratio for y01 and y11, plus pooled y10/y01/y11
alpha^2 * ||raw stage2 proposal after scale||^2 / ||input||^2 on y10/y01/y11
E0 versus SNR estimate, sigma2 estimate, rho on y00
aggregation: alpha and effective correction are pulse-level across 8 pulses x parent x 3 jammer variants; SNR is stored per parent x pulse and broadcast over the 3 jammer variants in matching C-order; report state-specific alpha ratios and E0/SNR, E0/sigma2, E0/rho correlations
checkpoint_policy: read-only exact epoch checkpoint, no replacement or selection
failure_policy: record identity/hash or state evaluation failure and stop affected checkpoint; do not silently drop
